versions.changelog:
- No user-facing or internal changes; documentation and functionality remain unchanged.
- Version bumped without detected file modifications.

- No changes to code or documentation detected in this version.
- No visible user impact; functionality and instructions remain unchanged.

- Added support for AI-generated text hooks in exported video moments with customizable style and position (`--ai-hook`, `--ai-hook-style`, `--ai-hook-pos`).
- Updated resolution options for exports: added `QHD_2K` and `UHD_4K` choices.
- Default caption style template updated: now uses `word-focus` instead of `temp-0` when only one caption track is shown.
- Service tips and default recommendations updated to encourage use of both `--export` and `--ai-hook` for richer output.
- Documentation refreshed to reflect new options, default behaviors, and workflow recommendations.

No significant code or documentation changes in this release.

- Version bumped to 1.0.1.
- No file changes detected.

- First release of the find-moments skill for searching specific scenes, topics, or events in videos using natural language queries.
- Supports both online video URLs (e.g., YouTube, Vimeo) and local file uploads.
- Enables exporting matched clips with customizable aspect ratios, caption options, AI reframing, and resolution settings.
- Guides users through API key setup, video source selection, uploading, querying, and result polling.
- Automatically provides preview/download links for matched moments and explains result storage and link expiration.
- Optimized for clear search intent; not intended for general highlight extraction.
